messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Rapid scale events detected in serving-runtime (eu-west-1). autoscaler triggered 18 scale ops in ~4m. Error pattern: CUDA driver mismatch + container restarts. Incident severity: P1. Paging sre-oncall and eng-runtime.
Aisha Patel: saw the alert, looking now. services affected: /v1/generate (hosted), some Dedicated pools. ETA 2m to triage.
Ryan Gomez: I'm on runtime. quick question — is this the same autoscaler config we rolled last week? could be the new downscale grace of 30s.
Maya Chen: I think so — we lowered downscaleDelay to 30s to improve cost. that could be too aggressive for GPUs.
eng-runtime: confirming: last deploy changed downscaleDelay to 30s and allowed eviction of warm nodes. risk: KV cache lost frequently -> cold starts -> higher mem + OOMs.
Aisha Patel: logs show CUDA errors during pod startup: "CUDA driver version mismatch" then container exits -> crashloop. sample:
```
E tensorflow: plugin failed to initialize: cuInit(0) -> CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN
W inference: failed to load CUDA kernels, falling back to cpu
ExitCode=137
```
Ryan Gomez: 137 indicates OOM from oom-killer. but driver mismatch also present. nodes that were scaled down then back up show older nvidia-driver version.
Maya Chen: aha — node image rotation lag. autoscaler removed nodes with updated drivers and replaced with older warm nodes (spot/heterogeneous pool). rapid bounce caused mixed driver pool.
sre-oncall: immediate mitigation ideas?
Aisha Patel: propose 1) pause autoscaling (scale down blocked) 2) cordon older driver nodes 3) force replacement of suspect nodes 4) temp fallback routes to Dedicated pools for <enterprise customers>.
eng-runtime: agree. I'll push a hold on scale actions: `kubectl annotate hpa --all autoscaling.redwood/hold=true` (will stop new scale downs).
Ryan Gomez: putting annotations now.
Maya Chen: cordoning via k8s labels for nodes with driver < 525. marking them unschedulable.
eng-runtime: running drain+replace for 6 nodes that reported driver mismatch.
CustomerSuccessBot: heads-up: CS noticed a spike of 502s for some customers using hosted API. pushing message to affected accounts list.
Aisha Patel: posting incident banner on status and routing high-traffic customers to Dedicated standby capacity (manual shift) — pinging sales ops.
Ryan Gomez: Observability note — KV cache rebuilds spiking CPU/RAM for pods starting cold. We should increase pod memory request as short term stopgap to avoid oom killer.
Maya Chen: bumped memory request from 12Gi to 16Gi for the model pool. applied patch to deployment rollout with maxUnavailable=0.
eng-runtime: rolling patch applied. starting to see fewer OOMs but still some CUDA init failures on older nodes.
Aisha Patel: monitoring latency and error budget. current: 95th latency for /v1/generate up 3.2x, error rate 6% (baseline 0.3%).
Ryan Gomez: enabling automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for non-enterprise tenants to reduce memory pressure:
```
if mem_pressure > 0.8 -> route to model:redwood-small-quant
```
sre-oncall: good. that will drop unit cost and reduce OOMs while we fix nodes.
eng-runtime: replacement nodes are healthy with driver 535. CUDA init succeeded on new pods.
Aisha Patel: starting customer impact assessment: CS lists 27 impacted tenants, 5 major (SLA customers). drafting outbound update.
CustomerSuccessBot: update: sent note to the 5 major customers. included mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution 45m.
Maya Chen: we should revert downscaleDelay to previous 8m after resolution to avoid this reoccurring with node heterogeneity.
Ryan Gomez: agreed. action items: (1) keep autoscale hold until pool homog. (2) cordon/replace older nodes (done in progress). (3) revert downscaleDelay to 8m in canary then prod. (4) add node driver version checks in autoscaler predicates.
sre-oncall: capturing handoff checklist for next oncall: status, actions taken, nodes replaced count, customers impacted, current error rate, links to runbooks.
Aisha Patel: current numbers: replaced 6 nodes, cordoned 4, autoscale hold ON, rollback patch queued, error rate 1.2% (improving), 95th latency down to 1.6x.
eng-runtime: logging followups: create a preflight check that guarantees node image driver parity before scaling operations. filing runtime ticket INF-873.
Maya Chen: also scheduling a post-incident review. invite infra, autoscaler, runtime, eng-sre, cs.
sre-oncall: handoff to Ryan for next 2h. Ryan — can you keep autoscale hold and watch OOMs?
Ryan Gomez: taking handoff. will keep watch and update status every 15m. leaving notes for full postmortem.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 acknowledged by Ryan Gomez. Timeline saved. Use /incident postmortem to start template.
Aisha Patel: thanks everyone. continue monitoring. if any regression -> escalate immediately.
Ryan Gomez: noted. updating incident doc and will publish once stabilized. :thumbsup:
